# Agent Manager

> Agent Manager is a loopback-only, SQLite-backed agent platform: task and
> conversation storage, immutable agent profiles, a durable turn queue, a
> durable operation queue for deferred triggers, a Pi Runner execution
> boundary and a Telegram secretary. This file is the machine-readable entry
> point for LLM readers; the human-readable detail lives in `docs/handbook/`.

## Snapshot

This handbook documents the committed platform as of base commit `fc7a3f7`
(T01 durable operations integrated). Tasks T02I (scoped execution
permissions), T03 (independent review executor) and T04 (analysis,
recommendations and approvals) are parallel tasks that have not landed in this
snapshot. Pending interfaces are labelled explicitly in the handbook; do not
treat them as implemented. This is not a final parity verification.

## Platform at a glance

- Default API address: `http://127.0.0.1:18767` (loopback only).
- Storage: one file-backed SQLite database in WAL mode, versioned by Alembic
  migrations `0001`–`0007`.
- Execution: `pi_runner` sandboxes each agent run; agent identity and runtime
  policy come from immutable `AgentProfile` revisions.
- Deferred work: every review/analysis/Git trigger is a durable `Operation`
  row, not a synchronous side effect.

## Handbook

- [Handbook index](docs/handbook/README.md): scope, discovery and verification.
- [Objects and links](docs/handbook/objects.md): Task, Conversation, Message,
  Turn, AgentProfile, ConversationRuntime, Operation.
- [Workspaces and routing](docs/handbook/workspaces-and-routing.md): workspace
  resolution, `agent_id` routing, sandbox paths and code isolation.
- [Profiles, runtime and skills](docs/handbook/profiles-runtime-skills.md):
  immutable revisions, runtime defaults, frozen execution and skills.
- [Task lifecycle](docs/handbook/task-lifecycle.md): statuses, worker, review
  cycle, resume and recovery.
- [Tools and API discovery](docs/handbook/tools-and-api.md): REST endpoints,
  JS tools, auth, idempotency and discovery commands.
- [Review](docs/handbook/review.md): current automatic review cycle and the
  pending independent review executor.
- [Analysis and recommendations](docs/handbook/analysis-and-recommendations.md):
  the analyzer profile and the pending evidence/recommendation interface.
- [Approvals and revisions](docs/handbook/approvals-and-revisions.md):
  optimistic revision checks and explicit-approval rules.
- [Knowledge and integrations](docs/handbook/knowledge-and-integrations.md):
  knowledge base, OpenViking, skills, files and Telegram.
- [Errors, security and isolation](docs/handbook/errors-security-isolation.md):
  error contract, auth boundary, sandbox guarantees and isolated instances.
- [Capability inventory](docs/handbook/capability-inventory.md): tool → API →
  executor → status mapping.
- [Verification](docs/handbook/verification.md): exact commands and a
  completion checklist.

## Discovery quick reference

```bash
# REST surface (authoritative list, no database touched):
PYTHONPATH=src .venv/bin/python -c \
  "from agent_manager.api.app import create_app; \
   app=create_app('sqlite:////tmp/probe.db'); \
   print('\n'.join(sorted(app.openapi()['paths'])))"

# Registered JS tool names (authoritative list):
grep -n 'name: "' src/pi_runner/policy.mjs

# Durable operation kinds and their executors:
grep -n 'OPERATION_KIND_\|worker.register' \
  src/agent_manager/operation_worker.py src/agent_manager/operation_handlers.py
```

## Verification quick reference

```bash
PYTHONPATH=src .venv/bin/python -m pytest \
  tests/test_operations.py tests/test_platform_tools_contract.py \
  tests/test_api.py tests/test_api_auth.py tests/test_persistent_conversation.py \
  tests/test_execution_contract.py -q
```

See `docs/handbook/verification.md` for the full bounded set and expected
outcomes. Only the coordinator runs the final full suite.
